```{r Custom Functions}
####################################################################################
####     Custom functions for data cleaning.                                    ####
####################################################################################

choose_country_y <- function(df, name, start_date, end_date, country){
  df <- df[df$COUNTRY %in% country,]
  coln_info <- names(df)[sapply(df, class) %in% c("character")]
  cols_info <- df[, (names(df) %in% coln_info)]
  coln_data <- names(df)[sapply(df, class) %in% c("numeric")]
  cols_data <- df[, (names(df) %in% coln_data)]
  strt_col_num <- which(colnames(cols_data)==start_date)
  end_col_num <- which(colnames(cols_data)==end_date)
  cols_data <- cols_data[,c(strt_col_num:end_col_num)]
  clean_df <- cbind(cols_info, cols_data)
  return(clean_df)
}

# Selecting Indicator types.
delete_info <- function(df){
  COUNTRY <- df[,"COUNTRY"]
  data_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, class) %in% c("numeric")]
  df_data <- df[, (names(df) %in% data_cols)]
  clean_df <- cbind(COUNTRY, df_data)
  
  long <- melt(setDT(clean_df), id.vars = "COUNTRY", variable.name = "year")
  return(long)
}

delete_info_trade <- function(df, name){
  index <- df[,c("COUNTRY","COUNTERPART_COUNTRY")]
  data_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, class) %in% c("numeric")]
  df_data <- df[, (names(df) %in% data_cols)]
  clean_df <- cbind(index, df_data)
  
  long <- melt(setDT(clean_df), id.vars = c("COUNTRY", "COUNTERPART_COUNTRY"), variable.name = "year")
  return(long)
}

# Function to calculate index for multiple countries from long data.
cal_index <- function(data, country, base_year){
  base_year <- as.character(base_year)
  df <- data[data$COUNTERPART_COUNTRY == country,]
  df$year_match <- as.character(df$year)
  
  base_value <- df[df$year_match == base_year,]
  base_value <- as.numeric(base_value$value)
  df$index <- df$value / base_value * 100
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  df_final <- df[, c("COUNTRY", "COUNTERPART_COUNTRY", "year", "value", "index")]
  
  return(df_final)
}

p_stars <- function(x, fix_spacing){
  starsA <- ifelse(x < 0.01, "***", ifelse(x < 0.05, "**", ifelse(x < 0.1, "*", "")))
  starsB <- ifelse(x < 0.01, "\\*\\s+\\*\\s+\\*", ifelse(x < 0.05, "\\*\\s+\\*", ifelse(x < 0.1, "*", "")))
  if (fix_spacing == T) {
    stars <- starsB
  } else {
    stars <- starsA
  }
  
  return(stars)
  # Paste for notes: 
  # p-value: *p<0.1; **p<0.05; ***p<0.01
}

ldif <- function(x){
  y = diff(log(x))
  return(y)
}
```

## Data cleaning process.
```{r Clean Data, include=FALSE}
################                                                    ################
################                                                    ################
####                                                                            ####
####     Cleaning data set and constructing a subset for less work.             ####
####     Settings are from "Settings to construct data set".                    ####
####                                                                            ####
################                                                    ################
################                                                    ################

####################################################################################
####     Creating GDP (in UDS) Long data frame.                                 ####
####################################################################################

# G1: Subset data set by country, frequency, and date range.
GDP_Q <- GDPQ %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% 
  .[.$INDICATOR == "Gross domestic product (GDP)",] %>%
  .[.$S_ADJUSTMENT == "Seasonally adjusted (SA)",] %>%
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Domestic currency",] %>%
  .[.$PRICE_TYPE == "Current prices",]
longGDP_Q <- GDP_Q %>% delete_info()
colnames(longGDP_Q) <- c("country", "year", "gdp_usd")
longGDP_Q$year <-  longGDP_Q$year %>% as.character() %>% as.yearqtr(.,format = "%Y-Q%q")
GDP_Q <- NULL

####################################################################################
####     Creating PPI Long data frame.                                          ####
####################################################################################

# P1: Subset data set by country, frequency, and date range.
PPI_Q <- PPI[PPI$FREQUENCY == df_frequency, ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% 
  .[.$INDICATOR == "Producer price index (PPI)",] %>%
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Index",]
longPPI_Q <- PPI_Q %>% delete_info()
colnames(longPPI_Q) <- c("country", "year", "ppi")
longPPI_Q$year <- longPPI_Q$year %>% as.character() %>% as.yearqtr(.,format = "%Y-Q%q")
PPI_Q <- NULL

####################################################################################
####     Calculating exchange rate cross rate.                                  ####
####     (Also calculating EU currencies).                                      ####
####     (Not entirely sure about EU currency methodology).                     ####
####################################################################################

# E1A: Home currency exchange rate.
ER_Q <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == df_frequency, ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>%
  .[.$INDICATOR == "Domestic currency per US Dollar",]
longER_Q <- ER_Q %>% delete_info()
longER_Q$date <- longER_Q$year %>% as.yearqtr(.,format= "%Y-Q%q") %>% as.Date()
colnames(longER_Q) <- c("country", "year", "er", "date")
ER_Q <- NULL
# E1B: For EU Currencies. 
long_ER_Q_EURO <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == df_frequency, ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% "Euro Area (EA)",] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>% .[.$INDICATOR == "Domestic currency per US Dollar",] %>% delete_info()
colnames(long_ER_Q_EURO) <- c("euro", "date", "er")
long_ER_Q_EURO$date <- long_ER_Q_EURO$date %>% as.yearqtr(.,format="%Y-Q%q") %>% as.Date
long_ER_Q_EURO <- eu_join_list %>% group_by(country) %>% 
  summarise(
    date = seq(eu_date,as.Date("2025-10-01",format = "%Y-%m-%d"),by = "quarter")
    ) %>%
  full_join(., long_ER_Q_EURO, by = "date")
long_ER_Q_EURO$euro <- as.factor(1)

jferq <- full_join(longER_Q, long_ER_Q_EURO, by = c("country", "date")) %>% 
  mutate(
    er = coalesce(er.x, er.y),
    euro = factor(case_when(
      is.na(euro) ~ FALSE,
      euro == "1" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
      ))
         ) %>% 
  as.tibble() %>% 
  .[c("date", "country", "er", "euro")]
colnames(jferq) <- c("year", "country", "er_usd", "country_euro")
longER_Q <- NULL
long_ER_Q_EURO <- NULL

# E2A: Counterpart country currency exchange rate.
ER_Q <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == df_frequency, ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>%
  .[.$INDICATOR == "US Dollar per domestic currency",]
longER_Q <- ER_Q %>% delete_info()
longER_Q$date <- longER_Q$year %>% as.yearqtr(.,format= "%Y-Q%q") %>% as.Date()
colnames(longER_Q) <- c("country", "year", "er", "date")
ER_Q <- NULL
# E2B: For EU Currencies. 
long_ER_Q_EURO <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == df_frequency, ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% "Euro Area (EA)",] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>% .[.$INDICATOR == "US Dollar per domestic currency",] %>% delete_info()
colnames(long_ER_Q_EURO) <- c("euro", "date", "er")
long_ER_Q_EURO$date <- long_ER_Q_EURO$date %>% as.yearqtr(.,format="%Y-Q%q") %>% as.Date
long_ER_Q_EURO <- eu_join_list %>% group_by(country) %>% 
  summarise(
    date = seq(eu_date,as.Date("2025-10-01",format = "%Y-%m-%d"),by = "quarter")
    ) %>%
  full_join(., long_ER_Q_EURO, by = "date")
long_ER_Q_EURO$euro <- as.factor(1)

jferq_cc <- full_join(longER_Q, long_ER_Q_EURO, by = c("country", "date")) %>% 
  mutate(
    er = coalesce(er.x, er.y),
    euro = factor(case_when(
      is.na(euro) ~ FALSE,
      euro == "1" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
      ))
         ) %>% 
  as.tibble() %>% 
  .[c("date", "country", "er", "euro")]
colnames(jferq_cc) <- c("year", "counterpart_country", "er_usd_cc", "countercountry_euro")
longER_Q <- NULL
long_ER_Q_EURO <- NULL

# E3A: Calculate the cross exchange rate (Base currency USD).
# Using E1A/B and E2A/B.
cross_er <- full_join(jferq, jferq_cc, by = "year") %>% as.tibble()
cross_er$cer <- cross_er$er_usd * cross_er$er_usd_cc
longCER_Q <- cross_er[c("year", "country", "counterpart_country", "cer", "country_euro", "countercountry_euro")]
longCER_Q$year <- longCER_Q$year %>% as.yearqtr()
# Above is the cross exchange rate for each country pair.
cross_er <- NULL
jferq <- NULL
jferq_cc <- NULL

####################################################################################
####    Create Trade Data in Local Currency.                                    ####
####    (Reversing the methodology in the DOTS guide).                          ####
####    (Also calculating EU currencies as it is required to calculate trade).  ####
####    (Not entirely sure about EU currency methodology).                      ####
####################################################################################

# T1A: Import montly trade for calculation.
Trade_M <- IMTS[IMTS$FREQUENCY == "Monthly", ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% .[.$COUNTERPART_COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,]
Trade_MM <- Trade_M[Trade_M$INDICATOR == "Imports of goods, Cost insurance freight (CIF), US dollar",]
long_Trade_MM <- delete_info_trade(Trade_MM)
colnames(long_Trade_MM) <- c("country", "counterpart_country", "date", "imports")
long_Trade_MM$date <- long_Trade_MM$date %>% as.yearmon(.,format="%Y-M%m") %>% as.Date()
Trade_MX <- Trade_M[Trade_M$INDICATOR == "Exports of goods, Free on board (FOB), US dollar",]
long_Trade_MX <- delete_info_trade(Trade_MX)
colnames(long_Trade_MX) <- c("country", "counterpart_country", "date", "exports")
long_Trade_MX$date <- long_Trade_MX$date %>% as.yearmon(.,format="%Y-M%m") %>% as.Date()
Trade_M <- NULL
Trade_MM <- NULL
Trade_MX <- NULL

ER_M <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == "Monthly", ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% dataset_restriction,] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>%
  .[.$INDICATOR == "Domestic currency per US Dollar",]
long_ER_M <- delete_info(ER_M)
colnames(long_ER_M) <- c("country", "date", "er")
long_ER_M$date <- long_ER_M$date %>% as.yearmon(.,format="%Y-M%m") %>% as.Date()
ER_M <- NULL

# T1B: Fix EURO problem.
long_ER_M_EURO <- ER[ER$FREQUENCY == "Monthly", ] %>% .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.)] %>% .[.$COUNTRY %in% "Euro Area (EA)",] %>% 
  .[.$TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION == "Period average",] %>% .[.$INDICATOR == "Domestic currency per US Dollar",] %>% delete_info()
colnames(long_ER_M_EURO) <- c("euro", "date", "er")
long_ER_M_EURO$date <- long_ER_M_EURO$date %>% as.yearmon(.,format="%Y-M%m") %>% as.Date
long_ER_M_EURO <- eu_join_list %>% group_by(country) %>% 
  summarise(
    date = seq(eu_date,as.Date("2025-10-01",format = "%Y-%m-%d"),by = "month")
    ) %>%
  full_join(., long_ER_M_EURO, by = "date")
long_ER_M_EURO$euro <- as.factor(1)

jfer <- full_join(long_ER_M, long_ER_M_EURO, by = c("country", "date")) %>% 
  mutate(er = coalesce(er.x, er.y)) %>% 
  as.tibble() %>% 
  .[c("date", "country", "er", "euro")]
long_ER_M <- NULL
long_ER_M_EURO <- NULL

# T1C: Calculate monthly trade in local currency.
long_calc_MM <- full_join(long_Trade_MM, jfer, by = c("country", "date"))
long_calc_MM$imports_lcc <- long_calc_MM$imports * 1000000 * long_calc_MM$er
long_calc_MX <- full_join(long_Trade_MX, jfer, by = c("country", "date"))
long_calc_MX$exports_lcc <- long_calc_MX$exports * 1000000 * long_calc_MX$er

long_MM_clean <- long_calc_MM %>% as.tibble() %>% .[c("date","country","counterpart_country","imports_lcc")]
long_MX_clean <- long_calc_MX %>% as.tibble() %>% .[c("date","country","counterpart_country","exports_lcc")]

long_M_All <- full_join(long_MM_clean, long_MX_clean, by = c("date", "country", "counterpart_country"))
long_Trade_MM <- NULL
long_Trade_MX <- NULL
long_calc_MM <- NULL
long_calc_MX <- NULL
long_MM_clean <- NULL
long_MX_clean <- NULL
jfer <- NULL

# T2A: Calculating Quarterly from monthly.
Trade_hc_list <- unique(long_M_All$country)
longTradeLcc_Q <- NULL
for (hc in Trade_hc_list) {
  long_M_partial <- long_M_All[long_M_All$country == hc,]
  Trade_lcc_partial_Q <- long_M_partial %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      year = as.yearqtr(date)
    ) %>%
    group_by(counterpart_country, year) %>%
    summarise(
      imports = sum(imports_lcc),
      exports = sum(exports_lcc),
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  Trade_lcc_partial_Q$country <- hc
  longTradeLcc_Q <- rbind(longTradeLcc_Q, Trade_lcc_partial_Q)
}
longTradeLcc_Q <- longTradeLcc_Q[c("year", "country", "counterpart_country", "imports", "exports")] %>% .[.$year >= restriction_start & .$year <= restriction_end, ]
## Above is the Quarterly trade (imports and exports) prices of each country set in its own currency.
long_M_All <- NULL
Trade_hc_list <- NULL
hc <- NULL
long_M_partial <- NULL
Trade_lcc_partial_Q <- NULL
```

```{r Join and Export Data}
# GDP data (for country).
head(longGDP_Q)
# PPI data (for country).
head(longPPI_Q)
# Cross exchange rate data.
head(longCER_Q)
# Trade data in local currency.
head(longTradeLcc_Q)

####################################################################################
####    Join and export subset data frame.                                      ####
####################################################################################
# Add GDP and PPI for counterpart country.
longGDPcc_Q <- longGDP_Q
colnames(longGDPcc_Q) <- c("counterpart_country","year","gdp_usd_cc")
longPPIcc_Q <- longPPI_Q
colnames(longPPIcc_Q) <- c("counterpart_country","year","ppi_cc")

# Join all long data frame.
master_df <- full_join(longGDP_Q, longPPI_Q, by = c("country", "year")) %>% 
  full_join(longCER_Q, ., by = c("country", "year")) %>% 
  full_join(longTradeLcc_Q, ., by = c("country","counterpart_country", "year")) %>% 
  full_join(., longGDPcc_Q, by = c("year", "counterpart_country")) %>% 
  full_join(., longPPIcc_Q, by = c("year", "counterpart_country"))

longGDPcc_Q <- NULL
longPPIcc_Q <- NULL

# Create dummy for seasonality.
master_df$Q1 <- grepl("Q1", master_df$year) %>% as.factor()
master_df$Q2 <- grepl("Q2", master_df$year) %>% as.factor()
master_df$Q3 <- grepl("Q3", master_df$year) %>% as.factor()

master_df <- master_df[!is.na(master_df$year),]
master_df <- master_df[!is.na(master_df$country),]
master_df <- master_df[!is.na(master_df$counterpart_country),]

write_csv(master_df, file = "OECD_1970-2025_Quarterly.csv")      # Save as csv.
saveRDS(master_df, file = "OECD_1970-2025_Quarterly.rds")      # Save as R data set.
master_df <- NULL
```
After cleaning, we export the dataframe so we can load it without redoing the cleaning process.
The "country_euro" columns is <TRUE> when the "country" is using the EURO currency as the exchange rate. Same for the "countercountry_euro" column as well. Note that this does not imply that the country is registered as a member of EU. The difference: "joined" EU vs "adapt" EURO as currency.
